question: What are the names of wines and their corresponding grape types?
sql_query: SELECT wine.Name, grapes.Grape FROM wine INNER JOIN grapes ON wine.Grape = grapes.Grape

question: What are the names of wines with scores higher than 90?
sql_query: SELECT Name FROM wine WHERE Score > 90

question: How many unique appellations are in Napa County?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Appellation) FROM appellations WHERE County = 'Napa'

question: Calculate the average price of wines for each year and list the results grouped by year.
sql_query: SELECT AVG(Price) , Year FROM wine GROUP BY Year

question: List the top 10 most expensive wine names, ordered by their price in descending order
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM wine ORDER BY Price DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the minimum score of wines for each grape variety?
sql_query: SELECT Grape, MIN(Score) FROM wine GROUP BY Grape;

question: Find the distinct winery of wines having price between 50 and 100.
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT Winery FROM wine WHERE Price BETWEEN 50 AND 100

question: Give the distinct names of wines made before 2001 or after 2008.
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM wine WHERE Year < 2001 OR Year > 2008

question: Give me the average prices of wines that are produced by appellations in Sonoma County.
sql_query: SELECT AVG(T2.Price) FROM appellations AS T1 JOIN wine AS T2 ON T1.Appellation = T2.Appellation WHERE T1.County = 'Sonoma'

question: List the grape, winery and year of the wines whose price is bigger than 100 ordered by year.
sql_query: SELECT Grape , Winery , Year FROM wine WHERE Price > 100 ORDER BY Year

question: How many distinct wineries in California produce Zinfandel?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Winery) AS WineryCount FROM wine WHERE Grape = 'Zinfandel' AND State = 'California';

question: What is the maximum score of wines for each grape type?
sql_query: SELECT grapes.Grape, MAX(wine.Score) AS MaxScore FROM wine INNER JOIN grapes ON wine.Grape = grapes.Grape GROUP BY grapes.Grape

question: What is the area of the appellation that produces the highest number of distinct wines before the year of 2010?
sql_query: SELECT T1.Area FROM appellations AS T1 JOIN wine AS T2 ON T1.Appellation = T2.Appellation WHERE T2.Year < 2010 GROUP BY T1.Area ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Name) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the maximum price for wines not produced in Sonoma county?
sql_query: SELECT MAX(Price) FROM wine WHERE Appellation NOT IN (SELECT T1.Appellation FROM appellations AS T1 JOIN wine AS T2 ON T1.Appellation = T2.Appellation WHERE T1.County = 'Sonoma')

question: Find the county where produces the highest number of distinct wines with score higher than 90.
sql_query: SELECT T1.County FROM appellations AS T1 JOIN wine AS T2 ON T1.Appellation = T2.Appellation WHERE T2.Score > 90 GROUP BY T1.County ORDER BY count(DISTINCT name) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find the top 3 wineries with the greatest number of distinct wines made of white color grapes.
sql_query: SELECT T2.Winery FROM grapes AS T1 JOIN wine AS T2 ON T1.Grape = T2.Grape WHERE T1.Color = 'White' GROUP BY T2.Winery ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT Name) DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which wines are from Napa Valley but not from the winery 'Robert Biale'?
sql_query: SELECT Name FROM wine WHERE Appellation = 'Napa Valley' AND Winery NOT IN (SELECT Winery FROM wine WHERE Winery = 'Robert Biale');

question: What are the top 5 wines with the highest scores, excluding those from the 'Zinfandel' grape?
sql_query: SELECT Name, Score FROM wine WHERE Grape NOT IN (SELECT Grape FROM wine WHERE Grape = 'Zinfandel') ORDER BY Score DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Find the buildings which have rooms with capacity more than 50.
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT building FROM classroom WHERE capacity > 50

question: What is the total number of unique instructors?
sql_query: SELECT count(DISTINCT instructor_name) FROM advisor

question: Give all the names of instructors, in order of salary from least to greatest.
sql_query: SELECT name FROM instructor ORDER BY salary

question: What is the maximum capacity of any classroom?
sql_query: SELECT MAX(capacity) AS max_capacity FROM classroom

question: Find the names and buildings of the top 5 departments ordered by the budget in descending order.
sql_query: SELECT dept_name , building FROM department ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the course titles and the corresponding buildings
sql_query: SELECT course.title, section.building FROM course INNER JOIN section ON course.title = section.course_title

question: Count the number of rooms in Lamberton with capacity lower than 50.
sql_query: SELECT count(DISTINCT room_number) FROM classroom WHERE building = 'Lamberton' AND capacity < 50

question: Retrieve the maximum salary of instructors for each course they teach, along with the course title.​
sql_query: SELECT MAX(i.salary) AS max_salary, t.course_title FROM instructor i JOIN teaches t ON i.name = t.instructor_name GROUP BY t.course_title

question: What the name of the student in the History department who has the highest total credits?
sql_query: SELECT name FROM student WHERE dept_name = 'History' ORDER BY tot_cred DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who are the top 3 students with the highest total credits, and what are their department names?
sql_query: SELECT s.name, s.dept_name, s.tot_cred FROM student s ORDER BY s.tot_cred DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the average salary of instructors in departments with a budget greater than the average budget of all departments?
sql_query: SELECT AVG(i.salary) AS avg_salary FROM instructor i JOIN department d ON i.dept_name = d.dept_name WHERE d.budget > (SELECT AVG(d2.budget) FROM department d2);

question: Which courses are prerequisites for more than one course?
sql_query: SELECT p.prereq_title FROM prereq p GROUP BY p.prereq_title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.course_title) > 1;

question: Find the total number of students and total number of instructors for each department.
sql_query: SELECT count(DISTINCT T2.name) , count(DISTINCT T3.name) , T3.dept_name FROM department AS T1 JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.dept_name = T2.dept_name JOIN instructor AS T3 ON T1.dept_name = T3.dept_name GROUP BY T3.dept_name

question: How many courses that do not have prerequisite?
sql_query: SELECT count(DISTINCT title) FROM course WHERE title NOT IN (SELECT course_title FROM prereq)

question: Show all titles and their instructors' names for courses in 2008, in alphabetical order by title.
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT(T1.title) , T3.name FROM course AS T1 JOIN teaches AS T2 ON T1.title = T2.course_title JOIN instructor AS T3 ON T2.instructor_name = T3.name WHERE YEAR = 2008 ORDER BY T1.title

question: Which course is taught in the building with the largest capacity classroom and what is the name of the building?
sql_query: SELECT course.title, section.building FROM course JOIN section ON course.title = section.course_title JOIN classroom ON section.building = classroom.building WHERE classroom.capacity = (SELECT MAX(capacity) FROM classroom)

question: Which departments offered courses in the Spring semester between 2000 and 2010, and how many courses did each department offer?
sql_query: SELECT c.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT title) AS num_courses FROM course c JOIN teaches t ON c.title = t.course_title WHERE t.semester = 'Spring' AND t.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 GROUP BY c.dept_name

question: Who are the top 5 instructors with the highest number of distinct courses taught?
sql_query: SELECT i.name, COUNT(DISTINCT te.course_title) AS num_courses FROM instructor i JOIN teaches te ON i.name = te.instructor_name GROUP BY i.name ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What airports have an elevation less than 250 feet?
sql_query: SELECT name FROM airports WHERE elevation < 250

question: What is the lowest elevation of any airport?
sql_query: SELECT MIN(elevation) FROM airports;

question: How many routes have a codeshare agreement?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM routes WHERE codeshare IS NOT NULL

question: What is the number of routes whose destinations are Russian airports?
sql_query: SELECT count(*) FROM routes WHERE dst_ap_country = 'Russia'

question: What are the top 5 highest airports based on elevation?
sql_query: SELECT name, elevation FROM airports ORDER BY elevation DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which country is each source airport mentioned in routes located in? List all the unique source airports and the corresponding countries.
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT(r.src_ap_name), ap.country AS airport_country FROM routes r INNER JOIN airports ap ON r.src_ap_name = ap.name

question: List the source and destination airport names from routes where the airline operating the route is based in Russia.
sql_query: SELECT r.src_ap_name, r.dst_ap_name FROM routes r JOIN airlines a ON r.airline_name = a.name WHERE a.country = 'Russia'

question: What are the name and elevation of the airport with the highest elevation in Russia?
sql_query: SELECT a.name AS Airport_Name, a.elevation AS Max_Elevation FROM airports a WHERE a.elevation = (SELECT MAX(elevation) FROM airports WHERE country = 'Russia')

question: What are the names of all airports whose elevation is between -25 and 25?
sql_query: SELECT name FROM airports WHERE elevation BETWEEN -25 AND 25

question: What is the name, city, and country of the airport with the highest elevation?
sql_query: SELECT name , city , country FROM airports ORDER BY elevation DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the name of the airline with the most routes?
sql_query: SELECT airline_name FROM routes GROUP BY airline_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the names of the top 5 airports where the most routes end, along with the count of those routes?
sql_query: SELECT dst_ap_name, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM routes GROUP BY dst_ap_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which destination countries have more routes than the average number of routes?
sql_query: SELECT dst_ap_country, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM routes GROUP BY dst_ap_country HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(route_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM routes GROUP BY dst_ap_country))

question: Find the destination airport and its country that receives flights from the highest number of distinct source airports, and include that number in the result.
sql_query: SELECT dst_ap_name, dst_ap_country, src_count FROM (SELECT dst_ap_name, dst_ap_country, COUNT(DISTINCT src_ap_name) AS src_count FROM routes GROUP BY dst_ap_name, dst_ap_country) AS route_counts ORDER BY src_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the total number of routes for each country and airline in that country?
sql_query: SELECT T1.country , T1.name , count(*) FROM airlines AS T1 JOIN routes AS T2 ON T1.name = T2. airline_name GROUP BY T1.country , T1.name

question: List the cities which have more than 2 airports sorted by the number of airports.
sql_query: SELECT city FROM airports GROUP BY city HAVING count(DISTINCT name) > 2 ORDER BY count(DISTINCT name)

question: Which are the top 3 airlines with the most active routes by counting the number of routes without codeshare for each airline?
sql_query: SELECT airline_name, COUNT(*) AS active_routes FROM routes WHERE codeshare IS NULL GROUP BY airline_name ORDER BY active_routes DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which airports serve as both a source and destination?
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT src_ap_name FROM routes WHERE src_ap_name IN (SELECT DISTINCT dst_ap_name FROM routes);

question: How many employees live in Canada?
sql_query: SELECT count(DISTINCT full_name) FROM employees WHERE country = 'Canada';

question: Who are the composers of tracks that belong to the Metal genre?
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT(composer) FROM tracks WHERE genre_name = 'Metal';

question: Which customers have support representatives from the same country, and what are the full names of those representatives?
sql_query: SELECT c.full_name AS customer_name, c.support_rep_employee_name FROM customers c INNER JOIN employees e ON c.country = e.country

question: What is the longest track in terms of duration and what is its length?
sql_query: SELECT name, milliseconds FROM tracks WHERE milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM tracks)

question: List the names of top 5 tracks with the longest playtime
sql_query: SELECT name FROM tracks ORDER BY milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many tracks are longer than 12 minutes?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) FROM tracks WHERE milliseconds > 720000;

question: What are the top 8 billing countries by the sum of invoice totals, and what are those totals?
sql_query: SELECT billing_country , SUM(total) FROM invoices GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC LIMIT 8;

question: What are the top 5 countries by number of invoices and how many do they have?
sql_query: SELECT billing_country , COUNT(*) FROM invoices GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List all album titles that have more than two tracks associated with them.
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.album_title FROM tracks AS T2 GROUP BY T2.album_title, T2.album_title HAVING COUNT(T2.album_title) > 2;

question: What is the count of customers that Steve Johnson supports?
sql_query: SELECT count(T2.full_name) FROM employees AS T1 JOIN customers AS T2 ON T2.support_rep_employee_name = T1.full_name WHERE T1.full_name = 'Steve Johnson';

question: What are the names of tracks with a length between 200,000 and 300,000 milliseconds?
sql_query: SELECT name FROM tracks WHERE milliseconds BETWEEN 200000 AND 300000;

question: Retrieves the city with the most employees and the corresponding number of employees.
sql_query: SELECT city, COUNT(DISTINCT full_name) AS num_employees FROM employees GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT full_name) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many Blues tracks are priced at or above the average price of all tracks?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) FROM tracks WHERE genre_name = 'Blues' AND unit_price  >= (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM tracks);

question: Find the title and duration of both the longest and shortest tracks.
sql_query: SELECT t1.name AS longest_title, t1.milliseconds AS longest_duration, t2.name AS shortest_title, t2.milliseconds AS shortest_duration FROM tracks t1, tracks t2 WHERE t1.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM tracks) AND t2.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM tracks)

question: What are the average invoice totals for cities where the average is greater than $5?
sql_query: SELECT c.city, AVG(i.total) AS average_invoice FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.full_name = i.customer_name GROUP BY c.city HAVING AVG(i.total) > 5 ORDER BY average_invoice DESC;

question: Which countries have total sales that exceed the global average sales per country?
sql_query: SELECT c.country, SUM(i.total) AS country_sales FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.country HAVING SUM(i.total) > (SELECT AVG(country_sales) FROM (SELECT SUM(i.total) AS country_sales FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.country) AS avg_country_sales);

question: Who are the top three support representatives with the most unique customers, ranked in descending order?
sql_query: SELECT e.full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.full_name) AS num_customers FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.full_name = c.support_rep_employee_name GROUP BY e.full_name ORDER BY num_customers DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which countries have customers that spent more than $50 in total, and how much did they spend?
sql_query: SELECT c.country, SUM(i.total) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.full_name = i.customer_name GROUP BY c.country HAVING SUM(i.total) > 50;

question: How many players are taller than 185 cm?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_name) FROM Player WHERE height > 185;

question: What is the highest overall rating among players?
sql_query: SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes;

question: Which players are shorter than 170 cm?
sql_query: SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height < 170;

question: Retrieve a distinct list of player heights and their corresponding preferred foot
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT p.height, pa.preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_name = p.player_name

question: How many unique leagues in England are mentioned?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) FROM League WHERE country_name = 'England'

question: Who are the top 5 tallest players?
sql_query: SELECT player_name FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List the names of all left-footed players who have overall rating between 70 and 90.
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_name = T2.player_name WHERE T2.preferred_foot = 'left' AND T2.overall_rating >= 70 AND T2.overall_rating <= 90

question: Who are the top 3 players with the highest overall rating, ensuring no duplicate player names are included?
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_name = T2.player_name ORDER BY overall_rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many players have 'Aaron' in their name?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_name) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE '%Aaron%';

question: Which players have an average sprint speed greater than 70?
sql_query: SELECT player_name, AVG(sprint_speed) FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_name HAVING AVG(sprint_speed) > 70;

question: Which players have a maximum potential greater than 75?
sql_query: SELECT player_name, MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_name HAVING MAX(potential) > 75;

question: Which players have an average overall rating greater than 70?
sql_query: SELECT player_name, AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_name HAVING AVG(overall_rating) > 70;

question: Identify the short names of the teams that have an average build-up play speed greater than 55 since January 1, 2015, and determine their corresponding average speed.
sql_query: SELECT Team.team_short_name, AVG(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS avg_speed FROM Team JOIN Team_Attributes ON Team.team_long_name = Team_Attributes.team_long_name WHERE date >= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY Team.team_short_name HAVING avg_speed > 55 ORDER BY avg_speed DESC;

question: Identify the player with the highest average sprint speed and acceleration by calculating the average of these attributes for players who have both sprint speed and acceleration above 70.
sql_query: SELECT pa.player_name, AVG((pa.sprint_speed + pa.acceleration)/2) as avg_speed FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE pa.player_name IN (SELECT player_name FROM Player_Attributes WHERE sprint_speed > 70 AND acceleration > 70) GROUP BY pa.player_name ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the top 5 teams with the highest average defensive pressure among teams that have above-average defensive pressure.
sql_query: SELECT ta.team_long_name, AVG(ta.defencePressure) as avg_pressure FROM Team_Attributes ta WHERE ta.defencePressure > (SELECT AVG(defencePressure) FROM Team_Attributes) GROUP BY ta.team_long_name ORDER BY avg_pressure DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Identify the teams that have maintained a high average build-up play speed by calculating the average build-up play speed for each team, considering only those with an average above 60.
sql_query: SELECT ta.team_long_name, AVG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) as avg_speed FROM Team_Attributes ta WHERE ta.team_long_name IN (SELECT team_long_name FROM Team_Attributes GROUP BY team_long_name HAVING AVG(buildUpPlaySpeed) > 60) GROUP BY ta.team_long_name ORDER BY avg_speed DESC;

question: Which players have records on at least 2 different dates, and how many dates does each have?
sql_query: SELECT Player.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS num_dates FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_name = Player_Attributes.player_name GROUP BY Player.player_name HAVING num_dates >= 2 ORDER BY num_dates DESC;

question: Who are the right-footed players with a maximum strength greater than 70, and what is their strength?
sql_query: SELECT Player.player_name, MAX(strength) AS max_strength FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_name = Player_Attributes.player_name WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' GROUP BY Player.player_name HAVING max_strength > 70 ORDER BY max_strength DESC;
